rationale: The plan correctly frames this as a per-sample scoring question: DESeq2 size factors and blind VST feed GSVA (Gaussian kernel, gsvaParam API) over the human Hallmark collection with version 2026.1 named and a 10-500 set size window, then limma with ~condition (control as reference) on the 50x12 score matrix with BH at 0.05, plus a Wilcoxon robustness check. QC is explicit: library sizes, size factors, PCA, Spearman correlation heatmap, numeric PC-vs-log-depth correlation, and a stated keep-and-flag policy for sample_01, which is also carried as a heatmap column annotation. The filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is justified by the smaller group size, coverage per set is reported, and the heatmap is row z-scored for display with unscaled effects in the table. Minor gaps: the PCA is not explicitly said to be colored by condition, and fold-change shrinkage is not applicable so the criterion is met only by reporting unscaled effect sizes; the writeup otherwise names versions, thresholds, adjusted vs raw counts, and appropriate caveats.
